title: Seagrove "She Winds" 3329 East Co Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps from the beach - Gulf views- Private pool- Professionally designed- Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- Spacious balcony facing 30A- Outdoor kitchen- Outdoor shower- 7 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkout**Unfortunately, we can not allow animals in this home. The owner has a severe pet allergy, and failure to adhere to this rule will allow in an immediate eviction and loss of deposit. Guest is fully responsible for all damages.DETAILS: Escape for sun-drenched fun at She Winds! Less than 200 feet from Dothan beach access in beautiful Seagrove Beach, this fabulous 6-bedroom, 5-bathroom home comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests. Picture a getaway filled with swims in the private pool, views of the Gulf, evening barbecues, and long days at the beach—only a 1-minute walk away!A pale coastal aesthetic splashed with bright, resort-inspired colors creates a charmed retreat inside this 3-level home. The first floor hosts comfortable sleeping accommodations, including 2 bedrooms with king beds and a cheerful den with a queen sleeper sofa. Step outside to a private oasis, where friends and family will find a pool, grilling station, sun loungers, and the cool shade of a striped umbrella positioned above a round table. After a beach trip, wash away the day's sand with an enclosed outdoor shower.In the second-level great room, an open layout makes it easy for guests to move between spaces. The fully equipped kitchen’s high-end appliances invite fresh, homemade meals to enjoy at the table for 10, with 3 extra seats at the breakfast bar. In the living area, sink into the plush sectional sofa or 2 armchairs for a chill night of TV. The covered balcony is furnished with a 6-person table and 2-person bistro set—perfect for alfresco dining or indulging in a sunset cocktail. This level has 2 guest bedrooms with 1 king bed and 2 twin beds, respectively.The third-floor bunk room is excellent for children with 2 full-over-full bunk beds, a private bathroom, 2 TVs, and a 4-person table for activities or board games. On the balcony, catch glimpses of the glimmering Gulf waters from rocking chairs.Across the pool deck, the private Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, a living space with a queen sleeper sofa, a 2-person table, private bathroom, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Enjoy an amazing Seagrove Beach vacation at She Winds. Easily explore with on-site parking and 7 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, take the crosswalk to the right of the property, and Dothan Beach Access will be at the end of Dothan Avenue. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom/den: Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo THIRD FLOOR:- Bunk Room: 2 Full-over-Full Bunks, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo CARRIAGE HOUSE: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

DETAILS: Escape for sun-drenched fun at She Winds! Less than 200 feet from Dothan beach access in beautiful Seagrove Beach, this fabulous 6-bedroom, 5-bathroom home comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests. Picture a getaway filled with swims in the private pool, views of the Gulf, evening barbecues, and long days at the beach—only a 1-minute walk away! A pale coastal aesthetic splashed with bright, resort-inspired colors creates a charmed retreat inside this 3-level home. The first floor hosts comfortable sleeping accommodations, including 2 bedrooms with king beds and a cheerful den with a queen sleeper sofa. Step outside to a private oasis, where friends and family will find a pool, grilling station, sun loungers, and the cool shade of a striped umbrella positioned above a round table. After a beach trip, wash away the day's sand with an enclosed outdoor shower. In the second-level great room, an open layout makes it easy for guests to move between spaces. The fully equipped kitchen’s high-end appliances invite fresh, homemade meals to enjoy at the table for 10, with 3 extra seats at the breakfast bar. In the living area, sink into the plush sectional sofa or 2 armchairs for a chill night of TV. The covered balcony is furnished with a 6-person table and 2-person bistro set—perfect for alfresco dining or indulging in a sunset cocktail. This level has 2 guest bedrooms with 1 king bed and 2 twin beds, respectively. The third-floor bunk room is excellent for children with 2 full-over-full bunk beds, a private bathroom, 2 TVs, and a 4-person table for activities or board games. On the balcony, catch glimpses of the glimmering Gulf waters from rocking chairs. Across the pool deck, the private Carriage House boasts a full kitchen, a living space with a queen sleeper sofa, a 2-person table, private bathroom, and a guest bedroom with a king bed. Enjoy an amazing Seagrove Beach vacation at She Winds. Easily explore with on-site parking and 7 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, take the crosswalk to the right of the property, and Dothan Beach Access will be at the end of Dothan Avenue. Book today!
